title: Fake Merc Character Study (part 14): Vulnerable LARP dog
summary: Part 14 of NH's drama series mocking YouTuber Jason Blaha, whom he labels a vulnerable narcissist. He attacks Blaha's 'vertical diet' advice to teenage clients, his imitation of Stan Efferding and Brian Shaw, his friends, his alleged sock accounts, copyright strikes, and real-life behaviour; the few training points concern teen nutrition habits, squat depth and box squats.
claims: Advising teenage clients to replace vegetables with orange juice and overconsume fatty foods leads to obesity and health problems
The vertical diet was designed for athletes coached by Stan Efferding; applying it to non-athlete teenagers is wrong
Teenagers need to build good dietary habits they can carry into adulthood
Taking naps or baths between sets is laziness, not luxury or athleticism
Vulnerable narcissists with no personality copy others, e.g. eating like famous strongmen to feel connected to them
Show me your friends and I'll tell you who you are: people who defend such figures usually share their problems
Going from a claimed 600 lb parallel squat to only 400 lb to depth is not a plausible ratio; regularly squatting to an 18-inch box inflates numbers
A coach who sabotages clients once they get stronger than him is acting out of ego
Cry bullies attack others online but recoil when met with the same energy
The only way out for a vulnerable narcissist is to prioritize the vulnerability and let go of the narcissism
